<function name="WorldToLocalAngles" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Translates a worldspace angle into an angle relative to the entity's coordinate system.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="ang" type="Angle">A worldspace angle.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Angle">The corresponding local space angle.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
